title: “Life throws up not only problems and disappointments, but also chances. You have to be able to consider them. And react to them in the right way. Kasztanka had a chance to change her life for the better. But she chose the familiar instead of the better. And in this sense, we understand Chekhov's story as a parable about human slavery, about the eternal attachment to the notorious “comfort zone”. This is what we want to tell our audience of the age of six,” says stage director R. Kiyakov.
